lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Hi, Commander!!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I'm Soline.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Word is that we're gonna be working together.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Look forward to it! Hahaha.
Likewise.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Having such a capable Nikke by your side

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: must really put you at ease.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Don't you worry, Commander,

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: you can leave everything to me.
You sound pretty reliable.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I sure am!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: You can bet your bottom dollar!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: A problematic passenger

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: got on my nerves today,

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: but chatting with you makes me feel much better.
What happened?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Well, it's always dangerous whenever

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: the train arrives at the station,

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: so I asked this passenger to step back a bit.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: However, he flips out on me all of a sudden,

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: stating that he can stand wherever he pleases.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I was just reminding him for his own safety!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I don't understand why he got so upset.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Anyway, I still tried my best to end the conversation with a smile.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Gosh, I'm starting to feel angry again

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: just thinking about it.
That was really professional of you!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Really? You think so?
That was very mature of you.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Hahaha, I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I feel a lot better

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: after chatting with you.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Thanks for listening to me, Commander.
I'm always here for you.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Now you're the reliable one!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Well, break time's over! Gotta go.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Looking forward to working with you!
